name: Favor for Krazek
summary: In Booty Bay, Krazek pauses his work on a broken crock pot to ask you for four loads of lesser bloodstone ore from the northern hills. He will return the cookware when you bring them.

sections.title: A Northern Bargain
sections.body: Krazek pauses his repair of the broken cookware in Booty Bay to offer a trade. He sends you far north to the Arathi Highlands. There, a cave in Drywhisker Gorge holds lesser bloodstone ore. The mineral is low grade, yet those who know its uses prize it.

sections.title: Ore from the Gorge
sections.body: Krazek keeps working on the pot while you travel north. He expects four loads of bloodstone and promises payment if you bring back enough. The ore must be mined. If you lack the skill, you need someone who can extract it.

faq.q: Who is Krazek and what does he want?
faq.answer: Krazek is a goblin in Booty Bay. As he repairs a broken crock pot, he asks you to bring back four loads of rare bloodstone ore from the north.

faq.q: Where is the bloodstone ore located?
faq.answer: Lesser bloodstone ore lies in a mountain cave in Drywhisker Gorge, far north in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why does Krazek want low-grade ore?
faq.answer: The cave's bloodstone is low grade, but Krazek says it has value for those with the craft and knowledge to use it.
Before Krazek makes his demand, you deliver the damaged vessel to Booty Bay in Krazek's Cookery.

faq.q: What happens after gathering the bloodstone?
faq.answer: After Krazek receives the four loads of ore and pays you, you continue with Return to Corporal Kaleb.

angles.text: As a miner, you can extract the ore yourself. Krazek warns that if you lack the skill, you need someone who can mine the veins.
